messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert P0 fired for region us-east-2 (az-3). Error rate > 5% for text-generation v2 endpoints. Automatic retries failing. PD incident: INC-14762.

pagerduty: Incident INC-14762 triggered, urgency: high. Notifying on-call.

alex (oncall): ACK - jumping in. seeing spikes on the error budget dashboard. tagging eng-sre and runtime.

mike (eng-sre): on it. pulling recent logs. can you confirm which pools are affected?

alex (oncall): looks like dedicated-pool-us-east-2-a and serving-fallback instances in az-3. cross-az peers stable.

jia (eng-runtime): grabbing runtime metrics... kv-cache miss rate up, gpt2-encoder serving errors 502 from worker 10. stack trace shows OOM in inference process.

sara (support): any customer impact yet? any active timeouts being escalated? got a ticket from corp-client-nyc reporting request retries.

alex (oncall): early numbers: about 4.8% of requests in us-east-2 are 5xx, latency 95p up from 120ms to ~2.4s. A handful of sessions hit persistent failures. Sending customer-facing note to major customers via status page after triage.

mike (eng-sre): identifying rogue batch size growth in autoscaler config for that pool, looks like a mis-evaluated metric causing overloaded GPUs. will throttle autoscale for that pool.

jia (eng-runtime): starting mitigation: pin model variant to cpu-fallback for a subset of traffic, and enable failover routing to us-east-1 for new requests. executing dry-run first.

alex (oncall): runbook reference: /runbooks/region-failure.md. Steps executed: 1) throttle autoscaler 2) enable failover route 3) monitor customer errors.

mike (eng-sre): command I ran: ```
# reduce autoscale max instances for pool
rctl autoscale set --pool dedicated-pool-us-east-2-a --max 8
```

jia (eng-runtime): dry-run routing command: ```
redwood route update --from-region us-east-2 --to-region us-east-1 --policy failover --dry-run
```

alex (oncall): PD: ACK recorded. pager duty shows acknowledged by alex. escalating to L2 for continued degradation.

pagerduty: Alert escalated to escalation level 1 -> contacting eng-runtime L2.

sara (support): posting interim status: "Partial degradation in us-east-2 affecting text-generation endpoints. Failover and throttling in progress, some retries may see higher latency." will update customers in 15m.

mike (eng-sre): confirmed autoscale tweak reduced creation churn. error rate trending down to ~2.2% but latency still elevated on warm connections.

jia (eng-runtime): now enabling weighted failover: route 30% -> us-east-1, keep 70% local to validate. applying: ```
redwood route set-weight --region us-east-2 --target us-east-1 --weight 30
```

alex (oncall): monitoring logs for downstream replication lag. any sign of KV sync issues?

jia (eng-runtime): KV sync lag minimal, but one worker group failing to recover; draining that group. ```
redwood worker drain --group us-east-2-az3-wg-7
```

mike (eng-sre): after drain, worker restarts succeeded and OOMs stopped on that group. overall error rate now ~0.8%.

sara (support): current customer impact: ~0.5% of requests impacted, mostly degraded latency. drafting postmortem note and customer follow-up.

alex (oncall): moving to stabilization. will keep PD incident open for now. scheduling 30-minute on-call handoff with jia as next responder.

jia (eng-runtime): acknowledged handoff. I will take next 4-hour window. documenting mitigation steps in INC-14762.

mike (eng-sre): follow-up action items: rollback autoscaler mis-eval, add guardrail to prevent runaway batch amplification, add better alerts for sustained OOM patterns.

sara (support): creating customer comms ticket: TKT-9231. will coordinate with product for root-cause summary.

alex (oncall): closing loop for this thread: failover and drain mitigations worked. keeping incident open for monitoring and RCA. next update in 60m or sooner. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident INC-14762 status: Investigating -> Mitigated (partial). Current severity: P1.

alex (oncall): handing to jia now. jia, please post final status before you go on break if all stable.

jia (eng-runtime): will do. thanks all for fast responses.

sara (support): adding cc to affected customer threads and updating status page now.
